 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 3 02-09-2025
No one appears on behalf of the petitioner though the State is present.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the following relief/s:
(i) issuance of an appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions to consider the adequate, reasonable and just compensation of the 80% land which was acquired by the respondents belonging to the petitioner for the purpose of construction of Neura-Daniyawan Bari Rail line without Patna High Court CWJC No.6009 of 2017(3) dt.02-09-2025 giving any opportunity to the petitioner to place her grievance in respect of price of their land or without making any enquiry as to ascertain the market value of land on the date of paid the 80% compensation Amount against the 80% acquired land of the petitioner;
Smt. Indu Devi vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30760404/
1 (ii) for a direction to the respondents to consider the case of the petitioner for grant of compensation amount at the rate of November, 2011 market value with reasonable interest from June,2000 to till date 2017 against the petitioner's acquired land, which was acquired by the respondents under Neura-Daniyawan Bari rail line Project during the period of 2006, but Respondents have paid the 80% compensation amount against the 80% acquired land approx. 2,03119.40=00(Two Lacs three thousand one hundred Nineteen rupees and Forty Paise only) on November, 2011 after more than five years of land Patna High Court CWJC No.6009 of 2017(3)
dt.02-09-2025 Acquisition at the rate of year 2006;
(iii) for a direction to the respondents to consider the case of the petitioner for grant of appropriate compensation amount with interest against of her rest part of useless land of the same plot after the measurement of petitioner's acquired land under the Land Acquisition Act, which was not acquired by the respondent authority.
3. The State has taken this Court to para-9 of the counter affidavit filed on behalf of respondent no.2, the Collector, Patna by which it has been recorded that earlier 80 per cent of the amount was paid on 19.03.2016 and the petitioner has put in her signature in token of the receipt (Annexure-K to the counter affidavit on behalf of respondent no.2).
6.
